merger_description:
Neptune BidCo US Inc., through its subsidiary Nielsen group (**Nielsen**), proposes to acquire 100% of the issued share capital of DoubleVerify Holdings, Inc. (**DoubleVerify**) (the **Acquisition**).

Nielsen is a global provider of audience measurement, media planning, and content metadata solutions. It measures audiences across television, audio, streaming and digital media, primarily serving media vendors by enabling them to assess audience reach and consumption. Nielsen also provides media planning and marketing optimisation tools, including cross-media planning, measurement and outcomes capabilities through Nielsen ONE.

DoubleVerify is a digital media verification, measurement and optimisation platform primarily serving advertisers and advertising agencies. Its products assess the quality of digital advertising impressions, including whether advertisements are fraud-free, viewable, brand-suitable and delivered in the intended geography.

determination_table_content.details:
When making a determination in Phase 1, the Australian Competition
and Consumer Commission (ACCC) undertakes a competition
assessment and considers whether it is appropriate for an
acquisition to be approved or subject to further assessment in
Phase 2 in accordance with section 51ABZJ of the Competition and
Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act). In doing so, the ACCC must have
regard to the object of the Act and all relevant matters, including the
interests of consumers.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notified acquisitions, see the ACCC’s merger assessment guidelines
and interim merger process guidelines.
In conducting its competition assessment, the ACCC has considered
the information and documents that were submitted with the
notification form and information from third parties.
The ACCC has determined that the Acquisition may be put into
effect as it considers that the Acquisition would be unlikely to have
the effect of substantially lessening competition in any market. In
reaching its decision, and based on the material before it, the ACCC
makes the following findings.
▪ Nielsen and DoubleVerify are not close competitors.
o Nielsen supplies media audience measurement services
for television, audio and streaming, which are primarily
used by media owners.
o DoubleVerify supplies digital advertising verification and
measurement services for digital advertising
impressions, which are primarily used by advertisers.
▪ The merged firm would be unlikely to have the ability and
incentive to engage in anti-competitive bundling or tying
post-Acquisition. given the two different customer groups
that would be served.
